title: The Signature Degree Requirements Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Required courses and graduation requirements by program, mapped term by term. The Degree Requirements Database records what each degree program demands for graduation: total credit hours, general-education cores, major requirements, electives, GPA minimums, and residency rules. Each requirement is a checkable record that a student can mark complete, producing a remaining-requirements list and a projected graduation term. The Signature side adds plain-language requirement maps and sample four-year plans built from the same records.
capabilities: Model every program's graduation requirements as checkable records
Track completed versus remaining credits by requirement bucket
Project graduation term from current pace and remaining requirements
Flag missing prerequisites in planned course sequences
Compare requirements across programs for transfer and double-major planning

title: The Signature Degree Requirements Database — Safety, limits, and ecosystem
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Requirements follow one catalog year per program; catalog-year changes can alter requirements. Projected terms assume steady enrollment and are estimates, not guarantees. Related databases: College Course Catalog Database, Prerequisite Relationship Database, Learning Objective Database.
